// diagnostic E2124

Jet.AttachTargetNotObserved

Jet can't attach to process {pid}: {cause}

What

Jet can't attach to process {pid}: {cause}

Why

An attach reads what a running program publishes about itself: its live snapshot and flight ring under `jet run --observe`, and its live blocks under `--checked-alloc` too. A process that publishes none of it has nothing to read.

Fix

Start the program with `jet run --observe` (adding `--checked-alloc` for `--lens=alloc`), then attach to the pid it runs as.
